description: Answer-side eval for the knowledge base (decision D45, plan 30 W1). Each case runs the real Ask pipeline (run_game_ai_request) against a local Ollama with the Deck's model tag and checks the reply without a judge model: must_mention (facts copied from the card, any-of groups), must_not_say (things the card contradicts), expect_fence (is a ```bonsai-spoiler fence present?), expect_branches (did a Strategy first turn end with the branch menu?), expect_card (the card that should attach, so a miss can be blamed on retrieval rather than on the model). Written by someone who read the cards on 2026-09-02 -- these are NOT blind retrieval rows and must never be copied into kb_eval_v2.json.
notes: must_mention groups are any-of: the group passes when at least one alternative appears in the reply (case-insensitive).

expect_fence false on low-narrative titles and on questions that name the entity (spoiler constitution rule 7). true only where the question itself asks for a story beat or ending. null = not checked.
expect_branches true on Strategy first turns only. Speed and Expert never get a menu.
app_id "" with app_name set mimics an EmuDeck shortcut; retrieval resolves the title from the name.
expect_attached false marks a control case where nothing should attach at all.
Calibration edits after a run are allowed for must_mention synonyms only, and are dated in the case note. Never edit a case to make a failing check pass for any other reason.
